name: tomorrow-mv-v2
description: Claude MV 明天会更好 V2: two verses as a 51.2-second full cut and a 38.4-second cut, built with Remotion; every sung syllable on the beat, seamless loop

scripts.render: remotion render Full out/tomorrow-mv-full.mp4 && remotion render Short40 out/tomorrow-mv-40s.mp4
scripts.cover: remotion still Cover out/cover.jpg && remotion still Cover34 out/cover-3x4.jpg && remotion still Cover43 out/cover-4x3.jpg
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run cover && npm run verify
